interactions.note: death_save() never gathers effects, so no d4. This depends on ambiguity 1 (proposed: a Death Saving Throw counts). Red.
A caster who blesses themself adds the d4 to their own Concentration save. Green.
Losing Concentration (Incapacitated, a second Concentration spell, recasting) must strip Bless from every target. Green.
The target cap is checked in _bless after the slot is spent and Concentration starts, and the refusal cites no page. Red (#6, #8, and through the Session).
Without the Holy Symbol and with a weapon in hand, the engine stows the weapon (log entry, free interaction) and only then refuses. Red.
A costed component can't be replaced by a pouch, and holy water isn't the component. Green.
_as_list passes an unknown name through as a str, and _bless crashes with AttributeError instead of refusing. Red.
Naming one creature twice must not give two d4s. Green. Same gap as SPL-06.
Range is checked only when the spell is cast (ambiguity 3). Green.
No d4 on checks or initiative; one d4 even with Advantage. Green.

interactions.with: GLOSS.action / one slot spell per turn
interactions.note: Bless spends the action; it can't be cast with the action already spent or twice in one turn. Green.
Paladin is in OUT_OF_SCOPE_CLASSES. Only the Cleric path is tested.

rulings_proposed.ambiguity: SPELL.bless#7: “Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw”: do Death Saving Throws and Concentration saves count?
rulings_proposed.ruling: Any roll the rules call a saving throw gets the 1d4, including Death Saving Throws and the Constitution save to keep Concentration.

rulings_proposed.ambiguity: SPELL.bless#6: “You bless up to three creatures within range.”: can the caster be one of the targets?
rulings_proposed.ruling: Yes. The caster is a creature within range and can bless themself as one of the targets.

rulings_proposed.ambiguity: SPELL.bless#6: “within range”: is range checked only at casting?
rulings_proposed.ruling: Range is checked only when the spell is cast. A target that later moves beyond 30 feet keeps the benefit until the spell ends.

rulings_proposed.ambiguity: SPELL.bless#6 (gap): the same creature named twice in one casting, or blessed twice.
rulings_proposed.ruling: Effects of the same spell don't combine (p.106). A creature named twice, or blessed by two overlapping castings, adds only one 1d4.

output.summary: I wrote 44 tests for SPELL.bless in tests/srd/test_spells.py, covering all 8 clauses. 38 pass and 6 are marked expected-to-fail (red). I ran each red test with xfail disabled to confirm it fails for the reason claimed. The engine gets the basics right: casting with a level 1 slot as an Action, 30 ft range with the 35 ft boundary, the Holy Symbol requirement (a Component Pouch or holy water doesn't replace it), V blocked by a gag or Silence, Concentration lasting up to 1 minute and ending on every target, the automatic d4 on attack rolls, ordinary saves and Concentration saves, no d4 on ability checks or initiative, only one d4 per creature, and 4 targets with a level 2 slot. The red tests are 5 bugs: (1) the target cap is checked inside _bless after the slot is spent and Concentration starts, and the refusal cites no page (level 1, level 2 and through Session.execute); (2) Death Saving Throws never gather effects, so they get no Bless d4 (under proposed ruling 1); (3) naming an object as a target crashes with AttributeError instead of a refusal; (4) a V,S,M cast without its material component stows the held weapon and logs it before refusing. The Paladin half of the class list is out of scope. The 5+ GP threshold needs per-item values, which the engine doesn't have. No scenario changes, since stage B found nothing that under-asserts or contradicts the SRD. I added 5 new cheats to loop/abuse-catalogue.md.
